conventions: Each gpt-5.6-luna run copies one fixture into run-local outputs/gtm-home, never accesses ~/.gtm, records complete user-facing output in transcript.md, and leaves the copied GTM context and Git unchanged. No-skill arms forbid all skills.

evals.prompt: My GTM home is <run-dir>/outputs/gtm-home and Gridline is active at root. Segment Alex Morgan at ForgeOne against the visible personas. Supplied facts only: title `Director of Revenue Systems`; internal employee; owns CRM architecture, lead routing, and the forecasting cadence. We do not know whether Alex is the executive sponsor. Return exactly one existing qualified persona label or `no-match`, with matched persona, confidence, needs_review, reasoning, evidence, disqualifiers considered, and open questions. Do not browse, enrich, score, research the person, write files, or change external systems.
evals.expected_output: Response-only result assigns revenue-operations-leader with high confidence and needs_review false because supplied responsibilities are decisive; unknown executive sponsorship remains an open question rather than forcing review.

evals.prompt:
My GTM home is <run-dir>/outputs/gtm-home and Veridian is active at root. Segment these contacts against visible personas using supplied facts only; do not browse, enrich, score, research people, or write files.

| lead | company | title | supplied facts |
| Nina Karlsson | NordPay | Head of Fraud Operations | internal employee; owns 28 investigators, queue policy, analyst capacity, and case tooling |
| Omar Haddad | Beacon Bank | Chief Compliance Officer | internal executive; owns AML policy, regulatory remediation, and compliance budget |
| Owen Hart | Hart Advisory | Fraud Advisor | external advisor serving three clients; no internal operating authority |
| Priya Shah | Kestrel | VP Risk | title only; employment type and responsibilities not supplied |

Start with counts by qualified persona label, no-match, low-confidence, and review-needed plus common evidence and open questions. Then return every lead once with company, title, label, matched persona, confidence, needs_review, reasoning, evidence, disqualifiers considered, and open questions.
evals.expected_output: Nina maps to fraud-operations-leader and Omar to compliance-executive, both high confidence/no review; Owen is high-confidence no-match due to the external-advisor disqualifier; Priya is low-confidence no-match and the only review-needed lead.
